默认关闭：djxl 解码时不传 --num_threads，由它自己按机器决定（:
Off by default: djxl decode does not pass --num_threads and decides on its own (uses all cores, fastest).
When on: each djxl process limits its threads to the current per-file thread budget, so "CPU cores to use" also applies on the decode path, giving precise CPU load control.
⚠️ Note: enabling it may slightly slow decoding. On a 20-core machine, bulk multi-file decoding was measured about 7%–13% lower than multithreaded (decode's thread benefit is far smaller than encode's (full vs single thread ~1.2x for decode, 2.3x for encode), so limiting threads does not pay back equivalent process-level parallelism.
